# YT SEO Architect

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/): AI YouTube SEO toolkit: keyword research, script &amp; tag generator, metadata audit, thumbnail analyzer. 100% Free &amp; Unlimited — no credits, no subscription, no catch.
- [Dashboard](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/dashboard): Full YouTube SEO dashboard with channel connect, AI coach, keyword research, channel audit
- [Tools](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/tools/): 54 free interactive YouTube SEO tools: tag generator, title scorer, keyword research, description writer, SEO auditor, CTR calculator, shadow ban detector, content planner, and more. No login required, works offline.

## Glossary (84 key terms)
- [YouTube Algorithm](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-algorithm): The recommendation system that decides which videos appear in search results, suggested videos, and the homepage for each viewer.
- [Session Time](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/session-time): Total time a viewer spends on YouTube after watching your video. The algorithm prioritizes videos that keep people watching longer.
- [Click-Through Rate (CTR)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/click-through-rate): The percentage of viewers who click on your video after seeing it in search results, suggested videos, or the homepage.
- [Average View Duration (AVD)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/average-view-duration): The average minutes a viewer watches your video before leaving. Higher AVD signals engaging content to the algorithm.
- [Audience Retention](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/audience-retention): A graph showing what percentage of viewers watch each moment of your video. Used to identify where viewers lose interest.
- [Watch Time](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/watch-time): Total minutes viewers have spent watching your videos. Combined channel watch time is a key monetization and ranking metric.
- [Impressions](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/impressions): The number of times your video thumbnail is shown to viewers across search, suggested videos, homepage, and other surfaces.
- [Revenue Per Mille (RPM)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/revenue-per-mille): Your total estimated revenue per 1,000 video views, including ad revenue, memberships, and Super Chat combined.
- [Cost Per Mille (CPM)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/cost-per-mille): The amount advertisers pay per 1,000 ad impressions on your videos. You earn 55% of this after YouTube's cut.
- [YouTube Partner Program (YPP)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-partner-program): YouTube's monetization program that lets creators earn revenue from ads, memberships, and other features after meeting eligibility requirements.
- [Ad Revenue](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/ad-revenue): Money earned from ads displayed on your videos, split 55/45 between creator and YouTube after advertiser payments.
- [Demonetization](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/demonetization): When YouTube removes ads from a video or channel due to content that violates advertiser-friendly guidelines.
- [YouTube Keyword Research](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-keyword-research): Finding search terms your target audience uses on YouTube to discover content, then optimizing videos to rank for those terms.
- [Long-Tail Keywords](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/long-tail-keywords): Specific, multi-word search phrases (4+ words) that have lower search volume but higher conversion rates and less competition.
- [Search Volume](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/search-volume): The number of times a keyword is searched on YouTube per month. Higher volume means more potential viewers but typically more competition.
- [Keyword Difficulty](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/keyword-difficulty): A score (0-100) estimating how hard it is to rank for a keyword based on competition from established videos and channels.
- [Title Optimization](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/title-optimization): Writing video titles that include target keywords while maximizing click-through rate through emotional triggers and curiosity gaps.
- [YouTube Tags](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-tags): Keywords added to video metadata to help YouTube understand the content and context of your video for search and recommendations.
- [Description Optimization](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/description-optimization): Structuring video descriptions with target keywords, timestamps, links, and CTAs to improve search ranking and viewer engagement.
- [Transcript SEO](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/transcript-seo): Using your video's auto-generated captions and transcript as SEO content that YouTube indexes and matches to search queries.
- [Thumbnail Optimization](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/thumbnail-optimization): Designing custom video thumbnails that increase click-through rate through contrast, emotion, text, and visual hierarchy.
- [Video Chapters / Timestamps](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-chapters): Time-stamped sections in video descriptions that let viewers jump to specific parts and appear as search result links.
- [Closed Captions (CC)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/closed-captions): On-screen text of video dialogue that improves accessibility, SEO, and viewer engagement across languages.
- [Video Sitemap](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-sitemap): An XML file that helps Google discover and index your video content with metadata like title, description, and duration.
- [YouTube Search Ranking Factors](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-search-ranking-factors): The signals YouTube's search algorithm uses to determine which videos rank highest for a given search query.
- [Dwell Time](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/dwell-time): How long a viewer spends watching your video before returning to search results. Longer dwell time signals relevance to the algorithm.
- [Keyword Cannibalization](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/keyword-cannibalization): When multiple videos on your channel compete for the same search keyword, splitting views and weakening your ranking potential.
- [YouTube Shorts](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-shorts): Vertical short-form videos (up to 60 seconds) that compete with TikTok and Instagram Reels, with unique algorithm and monetization rules.
- [Shorts Monetization](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/shorts-monetization): The specific requirements and revenue rules for earning money from YouTube Shorts, including the Shorts Fund and ad revenue sharing.
- [Video Hook](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-hook): The first 5-15 seconds of a video designed to grab viewer attention and convince them to keep watching past the initial drop-off point.
- [Content Pillar](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-pillar): A core topic your channel consistently creates videos about, forming the foundation of your content strategy and audience expectations.
- [Evergreen Content](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/evergreen-content): Videos that remain relevant and searchable for months or years after publication, consistently generating views without ongoing promotion.
- [Playlist SEO](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/playlist-optimization): Optimizing YouTube playlists with keyword-rich titles and descriptions so they rank in search and trigger auto-play sessions.
- [Cards and End Screens](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/cards-end-screens): Interactive elements on YouTube videos that link viewers to other videos, playlists, channels, or external sites during and after playback.
- [Channel Audit](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-audit): A systematic review of your YouTube channel's performance, SEO, content gaps, and growth opportunities across all metrics.
- [Competitor Analysis](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/competitor-analysis): Analyzing competing YouTube channels to identify their strengths, weaknesses, keyword targets, and content strategies you can learn from.
- [Content Gap Analysis](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-gap-analysis): Finding topics your audience searches for that your competitors haven't covered, creating opportunities for high-impact content.
- [Call to Action (CTA)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/call-to-action): A prompt telling viewers to take a specific action — subscribe, watch another video, comment, or visit a link — placed strategically in videos.
- [A/B Testing (Thumbnail Testing)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/ab-testing): Testing multiple versions of a video thumbnail by showing different variants to segments of your audience and comparing CTR performance.
- [YouTube Live Stream](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-live-stream): Real-time video broadcasting on YouTube that generates high engagement, notification triggers, and dedicated revenue through Super Chat.
- [Super Chat & Super Stickers](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/super-chat): Paid chat messages highlighted during live streams and Premieres. Creators earn 70% of the revenue from each purchase.
- [Channel Memberships](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-memberships): Monthly subscription tiers where viewers pay for exclusive perks like badges, emoji, and members-only content from your channel.
- [Premieres](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/premieres): A scheduled first-time video debut that combines the live experience of a stream (real-time chat) with polished pre-recorded content.
- [Community Tab](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/community-tab): A social feed on your channel where you can post text updates, polls, images, and videos to engage subscribers between uploads.
- [Vertical Video (9:16)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/vertical-video): Video shot in portrait orientation (9:16 aspect ratio) optimized for mobile-first viewing on YouTube Shorts and mobile feeds.
- [Mobile-First YouTube SEO](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/mobile-seo): Optimizing video content for mobile viewers who watch on small screens with different browsing behavior than desktop users.
- [Topic Authority](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/topic-authority): YouTube's assessment of your channel's expertise in a specific topic area, built through consistent, comprehensive coverage of related content.
- [Audience Demographics](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/audience-demographics): Age, gender, location, and device data about your viewers available in YouTube Analytics Studio.
- [Traffic Sources](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/traffic-sources): The channels through which viewers find your videos — YouTube Search, Suggested Videos, Browse, External, Playlists, and Notifications.
- [Shorts Algorithm](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/shorts-algorithm): The separate recommendation system for Shorts that prioritizes swipe-through rate, loop rate, and first-2-second retention.
- [Video Intro Structure](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-intro-structure): The optimal structure for the opening of a YouTube video that maximizes retention and sets clear expectations for viewers.
- [YouTube Analytics Studio](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-analytics): YouTube's built-in analytics dashboard providing detailed metrics on channel and video performance, audience behavior, and revenue data.
- [Gaming on YouTube](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/gaming-on-youtube): The dedicated YouTube gaming category with unique features like gaming-specific analytics and the Gaming homepage tab.
- [YouTube Studio](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-studio): The creator dashboard for managing videos, reading comments, analyzing performance, and configuring channel settings.
- [YouTube Premium](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-premium): A paid subscription that removes ads, enables background playback, and provides access to YouTube Music Premium.
- [Channel Branding](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-branding): The visual identity of your YouTube channel including banner art, profile picture, watermark, and consistent video style elements.
- [YouTube Creator Music](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/creator-music): YouTube's library of licensed music that creators can use in videos without copyright claims, with revenue-sharing options.
- [Copyright Claims & Strikes](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/copyright-claims): Legal actions on your videos when you use copyrighted content without permission. Claims affect monetization; strikes can get your channel terminated.
- [Community Guidelines](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/community-guidelines): YouTube's rules prohibiting harmful content like harassment, misinformation, violence, and spam. Violations can result in content removal or channel termination.
- [Trending Content Strategy](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/trending-content): Creating videos about current trends, viral topics, or news events to capture search spikes and algorithm boosts from high engagement.
- [YouTube Trending Tab](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-trending): A curated section on YouTube showing currently popular videos, personalized by region and based on engagement velocity.
- [Browse Features (Homepage)](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/browse-features): YouTube's homepage recommendation surface showing personalized video suggestions to logged-in users based on their viewing history.
- [Content Repurposing](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-repurposing): Adapting existing content into different formats (blog post to video, long-form to Shorts) to maximize reach across platforms.
- [Batch Production](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/batch-production): Recording multiple videos in a single session to improve efficiency, maintain consistency, and establish a reliable upload schedule.
- [Content Calendar](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-calendar): A schedule planning when to publish each video, organized around content pillars, trending opportunities, and audience activity patterns.
- [Cross-Promotion](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/cross-promotion): Promoting your content across multiple platforms (social media, email, other channels) to drive external traffic to your YouTube videos.
- [External Traffic](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/external-traffic): Views that come from websites, social media, or apps outside of YouTube, including embedded videos and shared links.
- [Video Backlinks](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-backlinks): Links from other websites to your YouTube videos or channel that improve search authority both on YouTube and Google.
- [Collaboration](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/collaboration): Creating videos with other YouTubers to cross-pollinate audiences, gain subscribers, and build authority through association.
- [YouTube Hashtags](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-hashtags): Clickable keyword tags in video titles and descriptions that help categorize content and appear in hashtag-specific search pages.
- [Mid-Roll Ads](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/mid-roll-ads): Ad breaks placed during a video (8+ minutes required) that significantly increase ad revenue compared to pre- and post-roll ads only.
- [YouTube Creator Academy](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-creator-academy): YouTube's free educational platform with courses on channel growth, content strategy, monetization, and production best practices.
- [Playlist Discovery](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/playlist-discovery): How viewers find and interact with YouTube playlists — through search, suggested videos, channel pages, and auto-play features.
- [Channel Trailer](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-trailer): A short introductory video (60-90 seconds) that auto-plays for non-subscribed visitors and explains what your channel offers.
- [Keyword Research for Small Channels](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/keyword-research-for-small-channels): Learn how to optimize keyword research specifically for small channels. This guide covers tailored strategies, common challenges, and proven techniques that work for small channels

- [Video SEO for Music Channels](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-seo-for-music-channels): Learn how to optimize video seo specifically for music channels. This guide covers tailored strategies, common challenges, and proven techniques that work for music channels channe
- [Channel Optimization for New Creators](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-optimization-for-new-creators): Learn how to optimize channel optimization specifically for new creators. This guide covers tailored strategies, common challenges, and proven techniques that work for new creators

- [Content Strategy for Channel Growth](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-strategy-for-channel-growth): Learn how to optimize content strategy specifically for channel growth.
